summary: Raleigh-Durham, North Carolina, software developer, self-taught programmer, open-source advocate, Groovy and Grails user, interested in machine learning and data mining, libertarian beliefs, enjoys reading (sci-fi, philosophy, tech), mountain biking, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, and live music (especially metal), participates in local tech meetups (RTP Hackers & Founders, TriJVM Hack Night), has experience with customer development and startup culture, values collaboration and co-founding partnerships, seeks to build enterprise software that improves user experience.
